body.prompt: Extreme macro close-up inside the same miniature diorama as the reference image: the forearm and gloved hand of one tiny construction worker in an orange hi-vis vest, wearing a small black wristband with one glowing amber LED. Very shallow depth of field, the rest of the job site is a soft warm blur of sand, palm trees and the yellow crane. Harsh midday Florida sun, tilt-shift miniature photography, the same colors and lighting as the reference. No text, no logos.
